Gºṃ ca tapovanaṃ).--§ 594 (Mṛtyu): VII, 54, 2098 (visited by Mṛtyu).--§ 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 18, 1301 (there Cāruśīrsha worshipped Śiva).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 83, 2478 (the sacrificial horse proceeded from G. to Prabhāsa).
